purpose: Accepted tenant GUC names for the RLS checker. The checker reads this file instead of hard-coding one name.
canonical_decision: OPEN - the owner decides which name every repository uses. This repository does not take that decision; it only records what the product repositories use today.

known_non_tenant_names.name: ottili.actor_ref
known_non_tenant_names.why: carries the acting subject, not the tenant discriminator

known_non_tenant_names.name: app.current_tenant_key
known_non_tenant_names.why: legacy ottilionev1 tables are keyed on tenant_key, not company_id

known_non_tenant_names.name: app.is_superadmin
known_non_tenant_names.why: role flag, not a tenant discriminator
